findings.label: Rate-limit keys collapse behind the proxy
findings.issue: With TRUST_PROXY=0 behind the Next.js D1 proxy, req.ip is the proxy's IP for every user: the login key becomes effectively email-only (anyone can lock any account out for 15 min with 10 bad attempts) and the write limiter becomes one 300/15min bucket for all users. Recorded only as a note in phase3-verification.md; no Phase 7 checklist item.
findings.action: Add a Phase 7 checklist item to set TRUST_PROXY to the real hop count and verify req.ip on the deployed chain without over-trusting a spoofable X-Forwarded-For.

findings.label: No per-IP login ceiling
findings.issue: The login limiter is keyed by IP + email only; rotating the email gives each attempt a fresh key, so one IP can password-spray at the write limiter's 300 per 15 minutes.
findings.action: Stack a coarse IP-only login limiter (e.g. 50 per 15 min) in front of the IP+email one, or document the trade-off.

findings.label: Check order omits pre-auth guards
findings.issue: CSRF 403, 415, 413 and the write limiter's 429 run app-wide before authenticate's 401; ARCHITECTURE §7 documents the order as starting at authenticate (401).
findings.action: Document the transport guards ahead of the 401 -> 403 -> 400 -> 404 -> 409 chain before Phase 4 ordering tests and docs/API.md.

findings.label: Bcrypt cost duplicated
findings.issue: Timing parity between unknown-email and wrong-password logins (measured 289 ms vs 292 ms) depends on two separate cost-12 literals; Phase 4 POST /users will add a third hashing site and tests hash at cost 4, so drift would go unnoticed.
findings.action: Export one BCRYPT_COST from lib/password.ts and use it for the seed, user creation and the dummy hash.

findings.label: Ownership not enforced over HTTP yet
findings.issue: findTaskInScope / visibleTasksWhere are correct and query-scoped but only exercised by direct calls; no route uses them yet.
findings.action: In Phase 4, load every task through these helpers (passing tx inside transitions) and add route-level tests: employee -> 404 on another's task, employee -> 403 on approve/reject.
